preconditions.description: The number of strings k must be between 1 and 26.
The length of the string q must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in q)
preconditions.description: The string q must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if len(set(q)) < k else True
postconditions.description: If the number of distinct characters in q is less than k, output 'NO'.
If a beautiful sequence exists, output 'YES' followed by k lines of the sequence.
Each string in the beautiful sequence must have a positive length.
